description: The mark, still in the margin

participation.context: Read the margin, and did not begin the prison or the end.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the old margin and left the three sheets as they were. You did not open the Holinshed.

title: Looked at York's margin

participation.context: Wrote York naming the rights, and stopped the speech where the breath stops.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the short passage under the crossed mark and left the messenger untouched.

title: Wrote York naming the rights until his breath stopped

participation.context: Wrote the page and did not continue it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You left the speech where his breath gives out, and you left the messenger as a mark.

title: Left York's speech where his breath gives out

participation.context: Wrote that the errand was not this week, and stayed at the board.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read your own third book and did not go to Paul's.

participation.context: Said the line at the window and did not add a blade.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said one blade once at the window, and you did not add a blade to what Alse had seen.

title: Said one blade at the window
